reviews.comment:
Lamentablemente me tuve que retirar sin poder cargar combustible. Primero porque no tienen todos los combustibles en cada isla, me solicitaron que me cambie de isla y cuando me tenían que cargar priorizaron la carga de la grúa del lugar, q llego dsp q yo, porque el chofer lo decidió y el chico de la playa no pudo hacer nada. Por lo tanto me retire del lugar sin ser atendido. Además  la grúa se estacionó en contramano del circuito normal de carga. Aparentemente el Sr. Chofer hace lo q quiere en el ACA San Luis.

(Translated by Google)
Unfortunately, I had to leave without being able to refuel. First, because they don't have all the fuel types at each pump island, they asked me to move to another island, and then when it was my turn to refuel, they prioritized the tow truck, which arrived after me, because the driver decided it and the attendant couldn't do anything about it. Therefore, I left without being served. Furthermore, the tow truck parked against the normal flow of traffic. Apparently, the driver does whatever he wants at the ACA San Luis station.
